title: Birth in Long Branch and family background
summary: Greer gives his birth date and place, his parents' work and his siblings, and says nobody in his family was musical.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Interviewing Mr. William 'Sonny' Greer, bon vivant, raconteur, legendary American music drummer, sometimes known as Mr. Empire State Building. Now, for the test of the microphone, Mr. Greer, would you just tell us when and where you were born.
I was born in Long Branch, New Jersey, December 13, 1902.
Okay, let's see how this is picking up. You say you were born in Long Branch, New Jersey, December 13, 1902.
How much do you know about your family background before --

My family background. I can remember all of my family. My mother's name was Elizabeth. My father's name was William Alexander. I was named after him but they always called me from the time I remember Son. They would say Son, and then they changed it to Sonny. My mother was a modiste and my father is master electrician for the Pennsylvania Railroad.

I have two sisters and a brother. They have all passed away now, but I remember them very well, and the funny part about it, I became a drummer by purely accident. It was nobody in my family musically inclined. You hear a lot

of guys, they say, oh, my mother was a pianist. My father was this or that, my sister, but that never happened in my family. There was nobody musically inclined in my family. My mother was a very famous modiste, a woman that could copy any kind of clothes, like rich people see a beautiful gown in the paper, they would show it to my mother and she could duplicate it.

My father was a master electrician with his own gang working under him for the Pennsylvania Railroad and my sisters, they -- my youngest sister, Madelyn, she became a very -- a hairdresser and my oldest sister was a housekeeper, you know, for a coffee magnate here in New York. My little brother was just on the scene, comme si, comme sa. You know.
